title: North Sikkim, Gurudongmar & Yumthang Valley
highlights: Yumthang Valley - the Valley of Flowers
Nathula Pass & glacial Tsomgo Lake excursion

days.label: Day 1
days.title: NJP / IXB to Gangtok - Arrival & Leisure
days.text: Pickup from Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or NJP Railway Station. Scenic drive to Gangtok. Check into your hotel, relax, and spend the evening enjoying the lively atmosphere of MG Marg.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Gangtok to Lachen via Chungthang Waterfalls
days.text: Morning departure for North Sikkim in a dedicated SUV. Drive through alpine landscapes, stopping at Butterfly Waterfall, Seven Sisters Waterfall, Chungthang Dam, and Naga Waterfall. Evening arrival in Lachen.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Lachen to Sacred Gurudongmar Lake & Transfer to Lachung
days.text: Early morning drive to the legendary Gurudongmar Lake at 17,800 ft, surrounded by glaciated peaks. Return to Lachen for lunch, then travel past Bhimnala Waterfall to reach Lachung for an overnight stay.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Lachung to Yumthang Valley & Return to Gangtok
days.text: Visit Yumthang Valley, renowned as the Valley of Flowers, with views of alpine meadows and hot springs. After lunch in Lachung, make the scenic drive back to Gangtok.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Gangtok to Nathula Pass, Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
days.text: Day tour to Nathula Pass on the Indo-China border (14,140 ft), Tsomgo (Changu) Lake, and the revered Baba Harbhajan Singh Memorial Temple.

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Gangtok to NJP / IXB Departure
days.text: Morning breakfast and departure transfer to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport for your onward travel.

included: Dedicated mountain SUV (Innova / Xylo) for all transfers
5 Nights hotel stays (3N Gangtok, 1N Lachen, 1N Lachung)
All meals in North Sikkim (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner) & breakfast in Gangtok
Gurudongmar, Yumthang & Nathula Pass restricted area permits
Pick-up and drop from NJP Railway Station / Bagdogra Airport
